items.title: Navalia: Advancing Cowork Agents through Verifiable Task Synthesis and Long-Horizon Post-Training
items.titleZh: Navalia：通过可验证的任务综合和长期培训后推进协同工作代理
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26887v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are evolving from conversational assistants into Cowork Agents capable of autonomous planning, tool use, and complex task execution. Financial analysis requires these agents to integrate cross-document evidence and perform multistep numerical reasoning, but expert task authoring is costly, while direct LLM synthesis struggles to produce challenging tasks with reliable answers. We introduce Navalia, a framework for Cowork Agents that combines verifiable task synthesis with long-horizon post-training. Using corporate financial reports as its data source, Navalia semantically selects supporting evidence from complete fact sets and constructs executable computation chains to generate analytical tasks with traceable evidence and actual data dependencies between steps. We further use independent LLM review and programmatic checks to verify evidence consistency and answer correctness. The verified tasks are then used for trajectory collection, cold-start supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL) to improve long-horizon task execution. Navalia, initialized from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, achieves consistent gains over the base model across all five benchmarks: OfficeQA Pro, FinSearchComp, Finance Agent Benchmark, APEX-Agents-AA, and Workspace-Bench-Lite. These results demonstrate that Navalia improves evidence integration, tool use, and long-horizon task execution capabilities and generalizes to broader Cowork settings, including general office tasks.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.26887v1 公告类型：新
摘要：大型语言模型（LLM）智能体正在从对话助理发展为能够自主规划、工具使用和复杂任务执行的协同工作智能体。财务分析要求这些代理整合跨文档证据并执行多步骤数值推理，但专家任务编写成本高昂，而直接法学硕士综合很难产生具有可靠答案的挑战性任务。我们引入了 Navalia，这是一个 Cowork Agent 框架，它将可验证的任务合成与长期后期训练相结合。 Navalia 使用公司财务报告作为数据源，从完整的事实集中语义选择支持证据，并构建可执行的计算链，以生成具有可追溯证据和步骤之间实际数据依赖关系的分析任务。我们进一步使用独立的法学硕士审查和程序检查来验证证据的一致性和答案的正确性。然后，经过验证的任务用于轨迹收集、冷启动监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL），以改善长期任务执行。 Navalia 从 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 初始化，在所有五个基准测试中均取得了优于基本模型的一致收益：OfficeQA Pro、FinSearchComp、Finance Agent Benchmark、APEX-Agents-AA 和 Workspace-Bench-Lite。这些结果表明，Navalia 提高了证据集成、工具使用和长期任务执行能力，并推广到更广泛的 Cowork 设置，包括一般办公室任务。

items.title: Large language model and reinforcement learning based autonomous construction and progress updates
items.titleZh: 基于大语言模型和强化学习的自主构建和进度更新
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26899v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Due to the rapid growth of the global population, traditional construction methods are gradually unable to meet the current housing demand. The advancement of machine learning algorithms has encouraged researchers to explore their applications in the construction industry, leading to more intelligent and efficient building processes. In particular, the rise of large language models in recent years has provided more possibilities for the transformation from traditional construction to smart construction. In this study, a large language model and reinforcement learning based autonomous construction method is proposed. An enhanced soft actor-critic reinforcement learning algorithm is developed to plan actions for a mobile crane according to construction tasks. Robot kinematics and control algorithms are used to ensure that the actions generated by the reinforcement learning algorithm can be executed by the crane. In addition, a customized embedding model is developed to extract information from the construction environment according to user interests. Then, a large language model, ChatGPT 5, is used to update construction progress, provide safety information to control system, and generate construction progress reports. The feasibility of proposed method is verified through several full-scall retaining wall construction experiments.

摘要：由于全球人口的快速增长，传统的建筑方式逐渐无法满足当前的住房需求。机器学习算法的进步鼓励研究人员探索其在建筑行业的应用，从而实现更加智能和高效的建筑过程。尤其是近年来大语言模型的兴起，为传统建造向智能建造的转变提供了更多可能。本研究提出了一种基于大语言模型和强化学习的自主构建方法。开发了一种增强的软演员批评强化学习算法，用于根据施工任务规划移动式起重机的动作。机器人运动学和控制算法用于确保强化学习算法生成的动作可以由起重机执行。此外，还开发了定制的嵌入模型，以根据用户兴趣从构建环境中提取信息。然后，使用大型语言模型ChatGPT 5更新施工进度，向控制系统提供安全信息，并生成施工进度报告。通过多次全尺寸挡土墙施工试验验证了该方法的可行性。

items.title: Pareto-Optimal RTL Code Generation via Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning with Large Language Models
items.titleZh: 通过大型语言模型的多目标强化学习生成帕累托最优 RTL 代码
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26904v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Recent studies have proposed reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) methods that enable LLMs to generate high-quality RTL circuits from natural-language specifications. Existing approaches optimize circuit PPA (Power, Performance, Area) by aggregating multiple objectives into a single scalar reward, making it difficult to simultaneously generate diverse Pareto-optimal solutions across different trade-offs such as low power, low latency, and small area. However, in practical design, the relative importance of each objective varies depending on product requirements and design constraints; thus, obtaining a diverse and high-quality candidate set is beneficial in that designers can choose a preferred trade-off a posteriori. In this work, we are the first to propose a learning method for LLM-based circuit generation that optimizes, not the quality of a single circuit, but the quality and diversity of the entire circuit set obtained through multiple generations in the PPA objective space. The proposed method consists of (1) a generation-based training pipeline that reformulates coverage improvement of the entire Pareto solution set into a sequential circuit generation problem, and (2) a reward function based on Hypervolume Contribution (HVC) that measures how much a generated circuit contributes to the Pareto front. Evaluation on the RTLLM v2 benchmark shows that the proposed method achieves +13.3 percentage points in relative Hypervolume over a baseline without PPA optimization and +14.4 percentage points over a single-objective reinforcement learning method, while also demonstrating superiority in circuit diversity.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.26904v1 公告类型：新
摘要：最近的研究提出了具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）方法，使法学硕士能够从自然语言规范生成高质量的 RTL 电路。现有方法通过将多个目标聚合为单个标量奖励来优化电路 PPA（功耗、性能、面积），这使得很难在不同的权衡（例如低功耗、低延迟和小面积）上同时生成多种帕累托最优解决方案。然而，在实际设计中，每个目标的相对重要性根据产品要求和设计约束而变化；因此，获得多样化且高质量的候选集是有益的，因为设计者可以事后选择首选的权衡。在这项工作中，我们第一个提出了一种基于 LLM 的电路生成的学习方法，该方法优化的不是单个电路的质量，而是通过 PPA 目标空间中的多代获得的整个电路集的质量和多样性。所提出的方法包括（1）基于生成的训练管道，它将整个 Pareto 解决方案集的覆盖率改进重新表述为顺序电路生成问题，以及（2）基于超体积贡献（HVC）的奖励函数，用于测量生成的电路对 Pareto 前沿的贡献程度。对 RTLLM v2 基准的评估表明，与没有 PPA 优化的基线相比，所提出的方法在相对超体积方面实现了 +13.3 个百分点，比单目标强化学习方法实现了 +14.4 个百分点，同时还展示了电路多样性的优越性。

items.title: MedPAO-Assist: Edge-Deployable, Modality-Aware Agentic AI for Radiology Report Structuring
items.titleZh: MedPAO-Assist：可边缘部署、模态感知的代理 AI，用于构建放射学报告
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26913v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: The adoption of Large Language Models for radiology report structuring has been largely dominated by either proprietary cloud-based models or large open models requiring high-end GPUs for deployment, which is a critical bottleneck for clinical adoption in radiology workflows that demand data privacy and offline operation. To address this, we present MedPAO-Assist, an edge-deployable agentic framework that generates structured radiology reports directly from radiologist dictation and voice commands, requiring only $\approx3.3$ GB peak RAM and achieving an average end-to-end latency of $\approx31$ seconds on a standard laptop CPU through an asynchronous, multi-threaded execution pipeline. The system currently supports four major imaging modalities -- Chest X-ray, Chest CT, Abdomen CT, and Brain MRI. To our knowledge, it is among the earliest agentic systems to run its entire pipeline with a Small Language Model (SLM) in the 0.6B-parameter range. This multi-agent architecture, built around an Extract-Ground-Generate paradigm, performs concept extraction, SNOMED-CT grounding, and structured report generation, followed by a speech-driven human-in-the-loop correction phase, together forming a fully "no-touch" reporting workflow that requires no keyboard input, external API calls, or internet connectivity. We evaluate each pipeline stage individually -- concept extraction, ontology grounding, and concept categorization and report hardware profiling results demonstrating the system's feasibility for real-time, CPU-only clinical deployment.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.26913v1 公告类型：新
摘要：用于放射学报告构建的大型语言模型的采用主要是基于专有云的模型或需要部署高端 GPU 的大型开放模型，这是在需要数据隐私和离线操作的放射学工作流程中临床采用的关键瓶颈。为了解决这个问题，我们推出了 MedPAO-Assist，这是一种可边缘部署的代理框架，可直接根据放射科医生的听写和语音命令生成结构化放射学报告，仅需要 $\approx3.3$ GB 峰值 RAM，并通过异步多线程执行管道在标准笔记本电脑 CPU 上实现 $\approx31$ 秒的平均端到端延迟。该系统目前支持四种主要成像模式——胸部X光、胸部CT、腹部CT和脑部MRI。据我们所知，它是最早使用 0.6B 参数范围内的小语言模型 (SLM) 运行整个管道的代理系统之一。这种多代理架构围绕提取-基础-生成范式构建，执行概念提取、SNOMED-CT 基础和结构化报告生成，然后是语音驱动的人机交互校正阶段，共同形成完全“非接触式”报告工作流程，无需键盘输入、外部 API 调用或互联网连接。我们单独评估每个流程阶段——概念提取、本体基础和概念分类，并报告硬件分析结果，证明系统对于实时、仅 CPU 临床部署的可行性。

items.title: DataPraxis: Scaling Analytics Tasks via Verified Workspace Evolution
items.titleZh: DataPraxis：通过验证的工作空间演进扩展分析任务
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26924v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: General-purpose agents are increasingly expected to perform professional analytics work, which requires sustained reasoning, iterative investigation, and reliable evidence. Training these capabilities requires diverse and challenging tasks. However, generating tasks directly from raw data often overlooks deeper questions that emerge through analysis and provides limited evidence for verification. To address these limitations, we introduce DataPraxis, an analytics task synthesis framework based on verified workspace evolution. The framework progressively enriches workspaces with validated findings and artifacts, then inherits and combines these workspaces to uncover deeper questions. It constructs tasks from accumulated findings and their dependencies, verifying analytical results both during evolution and after task assembly. Using this framework, we construct DataPraxis-5K, a dataset of 5,000 verified trajectories spanning diverse domains and output formats, to train DataPraxis-27B and DataPraxis-35B-A3B. DataPraxis-27B achieves 55.11 on DABStep and 51.9 on JobBench, matching or surpassing frontier models such as GLM-5.2. DataPraxis-5K is available at huggingface.co/datasets/stargazerhust/DataPraxis-5k
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.26924v1 公告类型：新
摘要：人们越来越期望通用代理能够执行专业的分析工作，这需要持续的推理、迭代调查和可靠的证据。训练这些能力需要多样化且具有挑战性的任务。然而，直接从原始数据生成任务通常会忽略分析中出现的更深层次的问题，并提供有限的验证证据。为了解决这些限制，我们引入了 DataPraxis，这是一个基于经过验证的工作空间演变的分析任务综合框架。该框架通过经过验证的发现和工件逐步丰富工作空间，然后继承并组合这些工作空间以发现更深层次的问题。它根据积累的发现及其依赖性构建任务，在演化过程中和任务组装后验证分析结果。使用此框架，我们构建了 DataPraxis-5K，这是一个包含 5,000 个跨越不同领域和输出格式的经过验证的轨迹的数据集，用于训练 DataPraxis-27B 和 DataPraxis-35B-A3B。 DataPraxis-27B 在 DABStep 上达到 55.11，在 JobBench 上达到 51.9，匹配或超越 GLM-5.2 等前沿模型。 DataPraxis-5K 可在 Huggingface.co/datasets/stargazerhust/DataPraxis-5k 上获取

items.title: Industrial Agentic AI: LLM-Driven New-Generation Agents for Smart Manufacturing
items.titleZh: 工业代理人工智能：法学硕士驱动的新一代智能制造代理
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26941v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are enabling agents to move beyond predefined workflows toward autonomous planning and execution, creating new opportunities for smart manufacturing. However, dynamic environments, complex physical constraints, and stringent reliability requirements hinder the direct deployment of general-purpose agents in smart manufacturing. This article presents a systematic overview of LLM-driven industrial agents. First, we analyze five key challenges and discuss the concept and core characteristics of industrial agents. We then establish a unified taxonomy covering application scenarios, embodiment forms, and five capability levels. Next, we propose a four-layer system architecture and detail its core modules and operational mechanisms for closed-loop task execution. Finally, we review representative applications across the industrial lifecycle and outline future research directions. This article provides a structured reference for the design, development, and application of industrial agents.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.26941v1 公告类型：新
摘要：大语言模型（LLM）使代理能够超越预定义的工作流程，转向自主规划和执行，为智能制造创造新的机会。然而，动态环境、复杂的物理约束和严格的可靠性要求阻碍了通用智能体在智能制造中的直接部署。本文系统地概述了法学硕士驱动的工业代理。首先，我们分析了五个关键挑战，并讨论了产业代理的概念和核心特征。然后，我们建立了一个涵盖应用场景、体现形式和五个能力级别的统一分类法。接下来，我们提出了一个四层系统架构，并详细介绍了其闭环任务执行的核心模块和运行机制。最后，我们回顾了整个工业生命周期的代表性应用，并概述了未来的研究方向。本文为工业代理的设计、开发和应用提供了结构化的参考。

items.title: Fix, Not Just Resample: Bounded Compiler-Guided Repair in Lean 4
items.titleZh: 修复，而不仅仅是重新采样：Lean 4 中的有界编译器引导修复
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26942v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Automated theorem provers often rely on sampling language models, but proof assistants like Lean reject each failed step with a precise error message --- information that pure sampling discards. To overcome this, we introduce a bounded, online step-level repair module. Our search samples $K$ candidate tactics at each step and repairs a failed tactic at most $R$ times. Instead of discarding failed tactics, we feed the compiler's error message to a pretrained repair model to fix individual rejected steps in place. This approach improves the solve rate over a sampling-only baseline across all tested candidate budgets ($K \in \{1,3,5,8\}$), achieving up to a $32\%$ relative gain and solving $82$ additional theorems on a $1{,}990$-theorem subset of the LeanDojo benchmark. Repair is not free: it trades extra runtime for reachable proofs. But the trade is predictable: repair pays most when sampling is constrained; its return is front-loaded, with the first repair attempt capturing $84\text{--}96\%$ of the total gain; and the gain comes almost entirely from shallow tactic-execution failures rather than structural errors such as type mismatches. This targeted repair successfully replicates on a second benchmark (Lean Workbook), nearly doubling the solve rate with zero regressions.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.26942v1 公告类型：新
摘要：自动定理证明器通常依赖于采样语言模型，但像 Lean 这样的证明助手会用精确的错误消息拒绝每个失败的步骤——纯采样会丢弃的信息。为了克服这个问题，我们引入了有界的在线步骤级修复模块。我们的搜索在每一步对 $K$ 候选策略进行采样，并最多修复 $R$ 次失败的策略。我们没有放弃失败的策略，而是将编译器的错误消息提供给预训练的修复模型，以修复单个被拒绝的步骤。这种方法提高了所有测试候选预算（$K \in \{1,3,5,8\}$）中仅采样基线的解决率，实现了高达 $32\%$ 的相对增益，并在 LeanDojo 基准的 $1{,}990$ 定理子集上解决了 $82$ 的额外定理。修复不是免费的：它用额外的运行时间来换取可到达的证明。但这种交易是可以预见的：当抽样受到限制时，维修费用最高；它的回报是预先加载的，第一次修复尝试捕获了总收益的 $84\text{--}96\%$ ；而且收益几乎完全来自浅层策略执行失败，而不是类型不匹配等结构性错误。这种有针对性的修复成功地在第二个基准（精益工作簿）上复制，在零回归的情况下，解决率几乎翻了一番。
items.author: Haotian Deng, Chris Farber, Sonal Narasimha, Samskrithi Sivakumar, Yexiang Xue

items.title: MAMath-Bench: Process-Aware and Robust Evaluation of Multimodal Multi-Agent Mathematical Reasoning
items.titleZh: MAMath-Bench：多模态多智能体数学推理的过程感知和鲁棒评估
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26943v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Mathematical reasoning is a fundamental capability for educational applications of Large Language Models (LLMs), where reliable problem solving requires not only correct answers but also coherent and verifiable reasoning processes. Multi-agent systems (MASs) have shown growing potential in this domain by leveraging collaboration and verification among multiple LLM agents. However, existing evaluations primarily focus on the correctness of final answers in text-only settings, offering limited insight into multimodal reasoning capabilities, the reliability of intermediate reasoning steps, and robustness against reasoning errors. To address these limitations, we introduce MAMath-Bench, a process-aware benchmark designed to evaluate the multimodal mathematical reasoning capabilities of MASs. MAMath-Bench comprises 1,003 problems spanning 11 mathematical categories, multiple difficulty levels, and several modalities, including text, images, and audio. It features fine-grained milestone annotations to evaluate systems across three dimensions: problem-solving correctness, reasoning-process reliability, and robustness to adversarial reasoning-chain perturbations. Our evaluation yields three key findings. First, multi-agent collaboration does not consistently improve final-answer accuracy over strong single LLMs. Second, collaboration can substantially enhance the coverage of intermediate reasoning, but such gains may come at the cost of increased reasoning redundancy. Third, current systems remain vulnerable to adversarial reasoning errors, particularly those involving subtle structural perturbations. The dataset is available at https://github.com/mira-ai-lab/AgentMath.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.26943v1 公告类型：新
摘要：数学推理是大型语言模型（LLM）教育应用的一项基本能力，其中可靠的问题解决不仅需要正确的答案，还需要连贯且可验证的推理过程。通过利用多个 LLM 代理之间的协作和验证，多代理系统 (MAS) 在该领域显示出越来越大的潜力。然而，现有的评估主要关注纯文本环境中最终答案的正确性，对多模态推理能力、中间推理步骤的可靠性以及针对推理错误的鲁棒性的了解有限。为了解决这些限制，我们引入了 MAMath-Bench，这是一种流程感知基准，旨在评估 MAS 的多模态数学推理能力。 MAMath-Bench 包含 1,003 个问题，涵盖 11 个数学类别、多个难度级别和多种模式，包括文本、图像和音频。它具有细粒度的里程碑注释，可以跨三个维度评估系统：问题解决的正确性、推理过程的可靠性以及对抗性推理链扰动的鲁棒性。我们的评估得出了三个主要发现。首先，与强大的单一法学硕士相比，多代理协作并不能持续提高最终答案的准确性。其次，协作可以大大增强中间推理的覆盖范围，但这种收益可能是以增加推理冗余为代价的。第三，当前的系统仍然容易受到对抗性推理错误的影响，特别是那些涉及微妙结构扰动的系统。该数据集可从 https://github.com/mira-ai-lab/AgentMath 获取。
items.author: Xinping Wang, Jie Ma, Rui Xing, Wensong Guo, Xiayi Zhang, Jianhao Deng, Zihao Zhou, Boqian Yang, Feijuan He

items.title: LightCRS: Lightweight Multi-Domain Conversational Recommendation System
items.titleZh: LightCRS：轻量级多领域会话推荐系统
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26948v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Conversational recommender systems have recently adopted vision-language models to match user dialogue intents with multimodal product information. However, extending these methods to many product domains faces a dilemma: deploying a separately adapted VLM per domain scales cost linearly with the number of domains and requires routing each dialogue to the right model, while naively merging all domains into a single VLM degrades accuracy because product characteristics vary widely across categories. We propose LightCRS, a lightweight, query-conditioned framework for unified multi-domain multimodal conversational recommendation. LightCRS precomputes multimodal product representations once offline with frozen encoders. Online, a compact 5.3M-parameter module fuses this evidence for each dialogue via query-conditioned cross-attention, whose parameters are shared across all domains, and compares candidates jointly with an inter-candidate Transformer. To enable rigorous evaluation, we construct MM-R2A-25, a 25-domain benchmark pairing natural Reddit recommendation-seeking conversations with Amazon product listings. LightCRS achieves state-of-the-art average HR@1, NDCG@5, and MRR, improving HR@1 by 35.4\% over the strongest baseline while reducing per-query latency by 266 times. Joint multi-domain training itself improves HR@1 by 15.2\% over separately trained single-domain models.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.26948v1 公告类型：新
摘要：会话推荐系统最近采用视觉语言模型来将用户对话意图与多模式产品信息相匹配。然而，将这些方法扩展到许多产品领域面临着一个困境：每个领域部署单独适应的 VLM 成本与领域数量成线性比例，并且需要将每个对话路由到正确的模型，而天真地将所有领域合并到单个 VLM 中会降低准确性，因为不同类别的产品特性差异很大。我们提出了 LightCRS，这是一个轻量级的、基于查询条件的框架，用于统一的多域多模式会话推荐。一旦离线，LightCRS 就会使用冻结编码器预先计算多模式产品表示。在网上，一个紧凑的 530 万参数模块通过查询条件交叉注意力融合每个对话的证据，其参数在所有域之间共享，并将候选者与候选者间 Transformer 进行联合比较。为了进行严格的评估，我们构建了 MM-R2A-25，这是一个 25 个域的基准测试，将自然的 Reddit 推荐寻求对话与亚马逊产品列表配对。 LightCRS 实现了最先进的平均 HR@1、NDCG@5 和 MRR，将 HR@1 比最强基线提高了 35.4%，同时将每次查询延迟减少了 266 倍。联合多域训练本身比单独训练的单域模型将 HR@1 提高了 15.2%。
items.author: He Ma, Lan You, Qiyang Wu, Chen Liu

items.title: When Planning Problems Become Hard for LLMs: Separating Structural Complexity from Semantic Interpretability
items.titleZh: 当规划问题对法学硕士来说变得困难时：将结构复杂性与语义可解释性分开
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26964v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) struggle with classical planning, but benchmarks rarely distinguish structural difficulty from the difficulty of interpreting symbolic vocabulary. We examine seven STRIPS domains with BFS-optimal plan lengths. For predicting structural difficulty without solving an instance, the zero-training delete-relaxation heuristic $h_{\mathrm{add}}$ outperforms learned alternatives on held-out domains (mean Spearman $|\rho|=0.931$), including ridge regression ($0.707$), object count ($0.657$), and the episodic retrieval architecture ARC ($0.400$). ARC also fails to outperform a linear model using the same features. To isolate semantic effects, we progressively rename predicates while preserving states, transitions, and optimal plans. Valid LLM planning success drops from $67.5\%$ to $40.0\%$ between $0\%$ and $100\%$ renaming, while refusals remain at $0\%$. An LLM supplied with ARC's conditioning information predicts difficulty in context better than trained ARC (mean $|\rho|=0.826$). Hybrid routing between an LLM and a symbolic planner depends more on calibration to the target LLM's outcomes than on the structural score selected. Thus, established symbolic heuristics already estimate structural difficulty well; improving hybrid planning requires modeling LLM behavior sensitive to predicate semantics rather than developing more structural predictors.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.26964v1 公告类型：新
摘要：大型语言模型（LLM）与经典规划相矛盾，但基准很少区分结构困难和解释符号词汇的困难。我们检查了七个具有 BFS 最佳计划长度的 STRIPS 域。为了在不解决实例的情况下预测结构难度，零训练删除松弛启发式 $h_{\mathrm{add}}$ 优于保留域上的学习替代方案（平均 Spearman $|\rho|=0.931$），包括岭回归（$0.707$）、对象计数（$0.657$）和情景检索架构 ARC（$0.400$）。 ARC 也未能优于使用相同特征的线性模型。为了隔离语义影响，我们逐步重命名谓词，同时保留状态、转换和最优计划。在 $0\%$ 和 $100\%$ 重命​​名之间，有效的 LLM 规划成功率从 $67.5\%$ 下降到 $40.0\%$，而拒绝率仍保持在 $0\%$。提供 ARC 调节信息的法学硕士比经过训练的 ARC 更好地预测上下文中的难度（平均值 $|\rho|=0.826$）。法学硕士和符号规划器之间的混合路由更多地取决于对目标法学硕士结果的校准，而不是所选的结构分数。因此，已建立的符号启发法已经很好地估计了结构难度。改进混合规划需要对谓词语义敏感的 LLM 行为进行建模，而不是开发更多的结构预测器。
items.author: Mayukh Debnath, Adeyinka Adedigba, Rammohan Mallipeddi

items.title: SPEM: Structure-Aware Procedural Memory for Efficient Skill Use in LLM Agents
items.titleZh: SPEM：结构感知程序记忆，可有效利用 LLM 代理的技能
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.26995v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: LLM-based agents increasingly rely on reusable skills. However, scaling skill libraries makes efficient and accurate skill use difficult. Full skill loading incurs high token and runtime overhead. In contrast, flat semantic retrieval treats skills as independent text entries, ignoring dependencies, execution order, state transitions, and data flow constraints. We propose SPEM, a lightweight structure-aware procedural memory framework for efficient skill use in LLM-based agents. SPEM maintains Atomic Skill Memory for individual skills and Skill-DAG Memory for reusable compositions derived from successful executions. For a new task, SPEM reuses high-confidence Skill-DAG templates when available. Otherwise, it retrieves atomic skills and invokes Skill-GNN for state- and structure-aware skill selection. Successful executions are written back as new Skill-DAGs, allowing procedural memory to accumulate over time. Experiments on ALFWorld and SkillsBench show that SPEM achieves the best overall effectiveness--efficiency trade-off, reaching 87.1% ALFWorld success and 38.38% SkillsBench reward while reducing token and runtime costs against strong baselines.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.26995v1 公告类型：新
摘要：基于法学硕士的代理越来越依赖可重用的技能。然而，扩展技能库使得高效、准确的技能使用变得困难。完整技能加载会产生高令牌和运行时开销。相比之下，平面语义检索将技能视为独立的文本条目，忽略依赖性、执行顺序、状态转换和数据流约束。我们提出了 SPEM，一种轻量级的结构感知程序记忆框架，用于在基于 LLM 的代理中有效地使用技能。 SPEM 维护个人技能的原子技能记忆和成功执行所衍生的可重用组合的技能 DAG 记忆。对于新任务，SPEM 会重复使用高可信度的 Skill-DAG 模板（如果可用）。否则，它会检索原子技能并调用 Skill-GNN 进行状态和结构感知技能选择。成功的执行会作为新的 Skill-DAG 写回，从而允许程序内存随着时间的推移而积累。 ALFWorld 和 SkillsBench 上的实验表明，SPEM 实现了最佳的整体效果——效率权衡，达到 87.1% ALFWorld 成功率和 38.38% SkillsBench 奖励，同时相对于强基线降低了代币和运行时成本。
items.author: Ran Zhou, Zehui Kong, Fanyu Lin, Jiaheng Liu, Zhen Zhang, Yuxiang Ren

items.title: Does Multi-Agent Collaboration Reduce Hallucination in Clinical Tasks?
items.titleZh: 多智能体协作是否可以减少临床任务中的幻觉？
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.27027v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems improve performance on clinical tasks, and that improvement is often read as evidence of a more trustworthy system. However, the two are not the same claim. A clinician acts on the stated reasoning and not only on the conclusion, so whether collaboration reduces hallucination, and what decides when it does, has to be measured in the reasoning too. Yet most evaluations score only the final answer. We evaluate four systems (a single-LLM baseline and three multi-agent topologies) across four models and three clinical tasks, scoring hallucination, under a factuality and faithfulness taxonomy, inside the rationale each system generates and reporting it alongside the task metric. We report that collaboration buys task performance but not lower hallucination as a rule, and no topology is reliably better than another. The effect differs by model: of the $36$ model--system--task comparisons, $12$ are large enough to resolve --- four decreases and eight increases, with no model on both sides. What sets the level, and the direction of any change, is the model rather than the topology or the number of agents. A self-correction experiment is consistent with this: shown its own flagged errors, every model except Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct reduces hallucination; the one model for which collaboration lowers hallucination gains the most, and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, the model whose hallucination it amplifies most, does not reduce its hallucination at all. We find that collaboration redistributes what its models can already do; it does not supply what they cannot.

摘要：多智能体 LLM 系统提高了临床任务的性能，这种改进通常被视为系统更值得信赖的证据。然而，两者并不是同一个说法。临床医生根据陈述的推理而不仅仅是根据结论采取行动，因此合作是否会减少幻觉，以及什么时候会减少幻觉，也必须在推理中进行衡量。然而大多数评估只给出最终答案。我们评估了四个系统（一个单一法学硕士基线和三个多代理拓扑），涵盖四个模型和三个临床任务，根据事实和忠实性分类法，在每个系统生成的基本原理内对幻觉进行评分，并与任务指标一起报告。我们报告说，协作可以提高任务性能，但通常不能降低幻觉，而且没有一种拓扑确实比另一种更好。效果因模型而异：在 36 美元的模型-系统-任务比较中，12 美元足够大，可以解决——四次减少和八次增加，双方都没有模型。决定任何变化的级别和方向的是模型，而不是拓扑或代理数量。自校正实验与此一致：显示了自己标记的错误，除了 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 之外的每个模型都减少了幻觉；协作降低幻觉效果最大的模型，而 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 模型（其幻觉放大程度最高）根本没有减少其幻觉。我们发现协作重新分配了其模型已经可以做的事情；它不提供他们不能提供的东西。

items.title: Teaching AI Agent to Play Poker Strategically Through Preference Optimization
items.titleZh: 通过偏好优化教 AI 智能体有策略地玩扑克
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.27028v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: A poker agent can make a legal move and still make a strategically poor one. We ask whether compact AI agents can exhibit strategic behavior under hidden information and whether preference optimization can improve beyond static and zero-shot policies. We first evaluate a static baseline and three frozen language models: SmallThinker, Qwen3, and Gemma-3 whose performance varies substantially between exact-game and six-player evaluation. We therefore propose Strategic Preference Optimization with KL-anchored Equilibrium (SPOKE), combining teacher-relative value penalties, policy anchoring, risk constraints, and structured rationale supervision, and compare it with SFT, DPO, GRPO, and GSPO. Across three runs of a SmallThinker-4B-A0.6B policy, SPOKE achieves the lowest mean exploitability in Kuhn (0.213) and Leduc (1.081) and the highest six-max top-1 agreement (0.775), while maintaining teacher KL comparable to SFT (0.522 vs 0.523). These results provide preliminary evidence that strategic preference optimization can improve strategic quality while preserving teacher-consistent behavior.

items.title: M-Plan: Comprehensive Planning For LLM Agents with Memory Arrangement
items.titleZh: M-Plan：LLM代理的全面规划与内存安排
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.27032v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents have recently demonstrated outstanding performance in single-turn tasks, yet they continue to struggle with long-horizon tasks, particularly in environments without prior training. A key limitation of single LLMs is their difficulty in processing long contexts, which stems from weaknesses in continuous decision-making and reasoning capabilities. Although existing multi-agent systems (MAS) equipped with long-term memory bases can partially address this gap, they mostly rely on knowledge reuse or summarization, an approach that is often constrained by directly retrieval without any adaptation for the current task, while the retrieved memory may contain much history noises waiting to be preprocessed. In contrast, MAS characterized by task-specific guidance often lack long-term memory specifically designed for the guidance. To address these challenges, we propose M-Plan, a closed-loop MAS framework that integrates long-term and short-term memory. By combining global-local and past-current guidance, M-Plan enhances agents' performance on multi-turn tasks while maintaining a plug-and-play design. During task execution, agents receive task-specific milestones and insights, and are provided with local hints only when confusion arises, which form global-local guidance together. These guidance generation and utilization construct the short-term memory as well. After task completion, relevant information about the current task is optimized or reorganized before being sent to the long-term memory storage for future retrieval. The designments mentioned above build a comprehensive framework different from other individual long-term or short-term memory works. Extensive experiments on multi-turn tasks including ALFWorld, Webshop, and PDDL across diverse models demonstrate that M-Plan outperforms multiple baseline methods in both accuracy and efficiency.

摘要：基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体最近在单轮任务中表现出了出色的性能，但它们在长期任务中仍然表现不佳，特别是在没有事先训练的环境中。单一法学硕士的一个关键限制是它们难以处理长上下文，这源于持续决策和推理能力的弱点。尽管现有的配备长期记忆库的多智能体系统（MAS）可以部分解决这一差距，但它们主要依赖于知识重用或总结，这种方法通常受到直接检索的限制，而没有对当前任务进行任何适应，而检索到的记忆可能包含大量等待预处理的历史噪声。相比之下，以任务特定指导为特征的 MAS 往往缺乏专门为指导设计的长期记忆。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 M-Plan，一个集成了长期和短期记忆的闭环 MAS 框架。通过结合全局-本地和过去-当前的指导，M-Plan 增强了代理在多轮任务上的性能，同时保持了即插即用的设计。在任务执行过程中，代理会收到特定于任务的里程碑和见解，并且仅在出现混乱时才提供本地提示，从而共同形成全局-本地指导。这些指导的生成和利用也构建了短期记忆。任务完成后，当前任务的相关信息会被优化或重组，然后发送到长期记忆存储以供将来检索。上述设计构建了一个不同于其他单独的长期或短期记忆工作的综合框架。对多轮任务（包括 ALFWorld、Webshop 和 PDDL）跨不同模型的广泛实验表明，M-Plan 在准确性和效率方面均优于多个基线方法。

items.title: Physical AI: Concepts, Techniques, and Challenges
items.titleZh: 物理人工智能：概念、技术和挑战
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.27045v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: In recent years, physical artificial intelligence (physical AI) has experienced rapid development, capturing significant attention in academia and industry. However, the field has yet to reach consensus on its definition, technical landscape, and core challenges. To address this gap, this monograph seeks to define physical AI, present its technical landscape, and examine each key technical subfield in depth. In doing so, it establishes a unified framework for Physical AI: artificial systems that perceive, model, and act upon the physical world through continuous feedback under real-world constraints. Further, this monograph distinguishes physical AI from conventional digital AI, embodied AI, cyber-physical systems, and digital twins. It develops the foundations of physical AI across physics, control, cognition, learning, and reasoning. It reviews key methodologies, including multimodal perception, physical data and simulation, world models, embodied foundation models, motor-control systems, multi-agent coordination, and hardware-software co-design. Furthermore, it examines applications spanning robotics, manufacturing, infrastructure, scientific experimentation, and autonomous services. Particular attention is given to sim-to-real transfer, reliability, real-time execution, evaluation, safety, governance, and long-term deployment. By connecting perception, prediction, decision-making, action, and adaptation in a closed loop, this monograph identifies the technical challenges and research directions required to advance from narrow automation toward more generalizable physical AI and, ultimately, physical artificial general intelligence (Physical AGI).

items.title: Web Agent Agentic Reinforcement Learning Decision Model Under Multi-Cost and Failure Risk
items.titleZh: 多成本和失败风险下的Web Agent代理强化学习决策模型
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.23857v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Intelligent agent interactions in real-world web environments are commonly constrained by request budgets, time delays, anti-crawling restrictions, and operational failure risks. Strategies solely optimizing task success rates often exhibit unusable phenomena such as "high success but high cost" or "low risk but conservative failure." This paper proposes a constrained agentic reinforcement learning model for web agents, unifying page access, search requests, and external API calls into a unified long-term decision-making framework with associated costs. It simultaneously incorporates cost budget constraints and tail risk control into the optimization objective: constructing a multidimensional cost vector comprising cumulative request count, total latency, and failure penalties to achieve budget compliance via Lagrange dual updates, while employing a CVaR risk term to suppress excessive exploration of high-failure-probability paths, thereby achieving an adaptive balance among "completion rate, cost, and risk."
 Experiments were conducted across 30-70 site/page templates and 800-1,500 end-to-end web tasks, including information extraction, price comparison, form submission, and cross-page navigation. Interaction sequences spanned 20-120 steps with tool scales of 30-200. Performance was benchmarked against unconstrained RL, budget-constrained RL, and rule-based/scripted web agents, quantifying task completion rates, cost-per-success, failure rates, and policy stability.
 Results demonstrate that at equivalent completion rates, our method reduces C-PS by 22%-31% and lowers failure rates by 18%-26% under high failure penalties. Under fixed budgets, task completion rates increase by 10%-16%, highlighting the necessity and effectiveness of constraint modeling for practical web agent deployment.

items.title: PolyGraph: Plan-Buffered CUDA Graphs for Adaptive Speculative Decoding
items.titleZh: PolyGraph：用于自适应推测解码的平面缓冲 CUDA 图
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.23861v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Adaptive speculative decoding changes the active batch size B and draft length d from one decode step to the next, whereas a CUDA Graph replays a fixed launch configuration. The resulting verification width M = B d forces serving systems to pre-capture many shapes, capture new ones on the serving path, or pad every step to the largest draft. We present PolyGraph, a plan-buffer mechanism for custom Triton kernels that avoids this choice. PolyGraph captures one maximum-grid graph and writes the active shape to GPU memory before each replay. Kernels skip tiles beyond that shape, while graph topology, allocations, layouts, pointers, and launch grids remain fixed; the update transfers only 28 bytes. On one NVIDIA H800, a trace-driven prototype with Qwen2.5-3B dimensions replaces 64 shape-specific graphs with one, matches the warmed baseline in observed step latency (17.7 vs. 17.8 ms P50), and reduces measured pre-serving graph-build time from 3,915 to 93 ms. Fixed-draft controls show that the benefit comes from avoiding padded payload: the P99 difference from MaxPad is negligible at zero padding waste but reaches an 18.7% reduction at 100% waste. Our evidence establishes a bounded work-shape mechanism for custom kernels, not a production serving system, and is limited to synthetic traces on one GPU.

摘要：自适应推测解码将活动批量大小 B 和草稿长度 d 从一个解码步骤更改为下一个解码步骤，而 CUDA Graph 则重放固定的启动配置。由此产生的验证宽度 M = B d 迫使服务系统预先捕获许多形状，捕获服务路径上的新形状，或将每一步填充到最大草图。我们提出了 PolyGraph，一种用于定制 Triton 内核的计划缓冲机制，可以避免这种选择。 PolyGraph 捕获一个最大网格图，并在每次重放之前将活动形状写入 GPU 内存。内核会跳过超出该形状的图块，而图形拓扑、分配、布局、指针和启动网格保持固定；更新仅传输 28 个字节。在一台 NVIDIA H800 上，具有 Qwen2.5-3B 尺寸的跟踪驱动原型将 64 个形状特定的图形替换为一个图形，与观察到的步骤延迟中的加热基线相匹配（17.7 毫秒与 17.8 毫秒 P50），并将测量的预服务图形构建时间从 3,915 毫秒减少到 93 毫秒。固定吃水控制表明，好处来自于避免填充有效负载：在零填充浪费时，P99 与 MaxPad 的差异可以忽略不计，但在 100% 浪费时减少了 18.7%。我们的证据为自定义内核（而不是生产服务系统）建立了一种有界工作形状机制，并且仅限于一个 GPU 上的合成跟踪。

items.title: Forecasting Patient Trajectories from the Electronic Health Records with Action-Conditioned World Models
items.titleZh: 使用动作条件世界模型从电子健康记录预测患者轨迹
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.23862v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: We introduce a predictive world model for electronic health records (EHR) that represents patient histories as action conditioned latent trajectories. Rather than modeling clinical events solely through autoregressive token prediction, our framework explicitly separates patient states from observed clinical actions and learns their evolution through a state and action conditioned transition operator. At its core is a state dependent linearization predictor that propagates local changes in latent patient state, enabling time resolved prediction, multi step rollout, and action conditioned simulation. Empirically, we show that generated latent trajectories preserve downstream predictive signal, temporal structure, and subgroup level statistical relationships present in encoder derived representations. We further decode free running rollouts into the original clinical feature space and evaluate future clinical measurements against observed values using task matched forecasting baselines, demonstrating that the learned dynamics retain predictive information beyond latent space agreement. Across binary classification and time to event tasks, EHR WM achieves competitive, though task dependent, performance relative to substantially larger EHR foundation models while using a 30x smaller parameter footprint. Finally, perturbing observed action sequences produces corresponding changes in generated trajectories, demonstrating the action sensitivity of the learned dynamics. Together, these results support world modeling as a complementary framework for learning explicit, time indexed representations of patient evolution from longitudinal EHR.

arXiv:2610.23862v1 公告类型：新
摘要：我们引入了电子健康记录（EHR）的预测世界模型，该模型将患者历史表示为行动条件潜在轨迹。我们的框架不是仅仅通过自回归标记预测来建模临床事件，而是明确地将患者状态与观察到的临床行为分开，并通过状态和行为条件转换算子来学习它们的演变。其核心是状态相关的线性化预测器，它传播潜在患者状态的局部变化，从而实现时间分辨预测、多步推出和动作条件模拟。根据经验，我们表明生成的潜在轨迹保留了编码器导出的表示中存在的下游预测信号、时间结构和子组级别的统计关系。我们进一步将自由运行的推出解码到原始临床特征空间中，并使用任务匹配的预测基线根据观察值评估未来的临床测量结果，证明学习的动态保留了超出潜在空间一致性的预测信息。在二元分类和事件发生时间任务中，EHR WM 相对于更大的 EHR 基础模型，在使用小 30 倍的参数足迹的同时，实现了具有竞争力（尽管依赖于任务）的性能。最后，扰动观察到的动作序列会在生成的轨迹中产生相应的变化，从而证明所学习的动力学的动作敏感性。总之，这些结果支持世界建模作为补充框架，用于从纵向 EHR 中学习患者演变的明确的、时间索引的表示。

items.title: SAGE-CP: When Marginal Coverage Hides Route-Conditional Failures in Adaptive VLM Ensembles
items.titleZh: SAGE-CP：当边际覆盖范围隐藏自适应 VLM 集成中的路由条件故障时
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.23864v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Adaptive VLM ensembles save computation by stopping early on easy images and escalating harder ones. Although a single conformal threshold can make the final predictor marginally valid, it can still fail severely along individual computational routes. We characterize this failure precisely: if a route has prevalence pi, marginal 1-alpha coverage allows its conditional coverage to fall to max{0, 1-alpha/pi}. To address this mismatch, we learn the router on development data, freeze all routing choices, and calibrate the returned score separately for early exits and escalated inputs. We call this pipeline SAGE-CP. Its calibration step applies Mondrian split conformal prediction to the operational groups created by the router. Under exchangeability, the resulting prediction sets achieve finite-sample coverage within each route. Across 10 benchmarks, 4 frozen VLMs, and 5 aligned splits, both global calibration and SAGE-CP achieve 0.900 marginal coverage at a 0.90 target, but their route behavior differs substantially. SAGE-CP raises mean worst-route coverage from 0.623 to 0.887 and reduces the mean route-coverage gap from 0.324 to 0.025, using the same routed scores and 1.177 source calls per image. The stronger guarantee increases the mean prediction-set size from 1.893 to 2.212; nevertheless, the sets remain smaller than those of the full ensemble (2.486) while requiring 70.6 percent fewer source calls. The route-level reliability persists across 6 fixed query fractions, while finer exit-depth groups demonstrate the need for additional calibration data on rare routes. Across 5 datasets, SAGE-CP also reduces measured batch-one latency by 58.8 to 63.4 percent and gross GPU energy by 55.7 to 57.5 percent relative to full inference. Thus, routing provides computational savings, while route-stratified calibration attaches coverage guarantees to the operational paths created by the router.

arXiv:2610.23864v1 公告类型：新
摘要：自适应 VLM 集成通过提前停止简单图像并升级较难图像来节省计算量。尽管单个共形阈值可以使最终预测器稍微有效，但它仍然可能沿着各个计算路线严重失败。我们精确地描述了这种失败：如果一条路线的流行度为 pi，则边际 1-alpha 覆盖率允许其条件覆盖率降至 max{0, 1-alpha/pi}。为了解决这种不匹配问题，我们根据开发数据学习路由器，冻结所有路由选择，并分别针对早期退出和升级输入校准返回的分数。我们将此管道称为 SAGE-CP。其校准步骤将蒙德里安分裂共形预测应用于路由器创建的操作组。在可交换性下，生成的预测集在每条路线内实现有限样本覆盖。在 10 个基准、4 个冻结的 VLM 和 5 个对齐的分割中，全局校准和 SAGE-CP 均以 0.90 的目标实现了 0.900 的边际覆盖率，但它们的路线行为存在很大差异。 SAGE-CP 使用相同的路由分数和每个图像 1.177 个源调用，将平均最差路由覆盖率从 0.623 提高到 0.887，并将平均路由覆盖率差距从 0.324 降低到 0.025。更强的保证将平均预测集大小从 1.893 增加到 2.212；尽管如此，这些集合仍然小于完整集合的集合 (2.486)，同时需要的源调用减少了 70.6%。路线级可靠性在 6 个固定查询分数中保持不变，而更精细的出口深度组表明需要对稀有路线进行额外的校准数据。在 5 个数据集上，相对于完整推理，SAGE-CP 还将测得的第一批延迟降低了 58.8% 至 63.4%，总 GPU 能耗降低了 55.7% 至 57.5%。因此，路由可以节省计算量，而路由分层校准则可以为路由器创建的操作路径提供覆盖保证。

items.title: Announced Breaks Separate Conformal Reliability from Frequency Calibration
items.titleZh: 宣布打破了保形可靠性与频率校准的分离
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.23917v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: An announced boundary reveals the partition before the first affected outcome, and a reset there serves one of two audits. The per-time audit reads conformal reliability, the expected distance of the threshold's coverage from nominal at miscoverage 0.1. The frequency audit reads frequency calibration, whether a closed window's error rate matched it. The reset rule, the post-boundary empirical quantile, attains the minimax per-time rate for independent scores. On bounded scores a recursion reset at the boundary attains a frequency gap of order one over the count when its floor adds a bounded total. At the 50th forecast after a large synthetic break, the reset rule's per-time gap stands below that of five adaptive methods, four from their authors' code, with every paired band below zero. After an electricity market reform, on 68 unseen scores, the band stands below zero against two, includes zero against two, adaptive conformal inference among them, and is a point at zero against one. After monetary policy decisions its pointwise band stands above zero against all five on 10 of the first 34 days. Of 9 announced boundaries one clears the smallest coverage difference its window detects, where every method's per-time gap at the 50th forecast exceeds the nominal miscoverage. Over the first 50 forecasts the reset recursion leads the frequency audit after every synthetic break.

摘要：公布的边界揭示了第一个受影响结果之前的分区，并且那里的重置服务于两个审计之一。每次审核读取保形可靠性，即误覆盖率为 0.1 时阈值覆盖范围与标称值的预期距离。频率审计读取频率校准，关闭窗口的错误率是否与其匹配。重置规则（后边界经验分位数）获得独立分数的每次最小最大速率。在有界分数上，当其下限添加有界总数时，边界处的递归重置会获得计数上一阶的频率间隙。在大的综合中断后的第 50 次预测中，重置规则的每次差距低于五种自适应方法，其中四种来自其作者的代码，每个配对带都低于零。电力市场改革后，在 68 个看不见的分数上，该区间处于零对二以下，包括零对二，其中自适应共形推理，并且是零对一的点。货币政策决定后，前 34 天中有 10 天，其点位区间相对于所有五个交易日均高于零。在 9 个已公布的边界中，有一个边界清除了其窗口检测到的最小覆盖差异，其中每种方法在第 50 次预测时的每次差距都超过了名义错误覆盖。在前 50 个预测中，重置递归在每次合成中断后的频率审计中领先。

items.title: Zero-Shot Tabular Learning via Hypergraph Reasoning with LLMs
items.titleZh: 通过法学硕士的超图推理进行零样本表格学习
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.23923v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Tabular data are prevalent across diverse domains such as healthcare and finance. Zero-shot tabular learning aims to make predictions without labeled data. However, existing LLM-based approaches rely on row-wise prompting, resulting in high inference cost and limited use of inter-row dependencies. In this work, we propose TABHGR+, an efficient relation-aware zero-shot framework for tabular data that leverages LLM-generated rules to label and group rows. Specifically, based on column and task descriptions, we use LLMs to generate rules that assign weak labels to all rows. To refine these noisy weak labels, we construct a hypergraph by grouping semantically related rows using LLM-generated rules and perform hypergraph-based label propagation. Lastly, we further enhance the LLM-generated hypergraph for propagation, which is potentially sub-optimal, by assigning label-adaptive weights to hyperedges. By requiring only a constant number of LLM calls independent of dataset size, TABHGR+ substantially reduces inference cost while achieving higher classification accuracy than zero-shot and strong few-shot baselines.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.23923v1 公告类型：新
摘要：表格数据在医疗保健和金融等不同领域普遍存在。零样本表格学习旨在在没有标记数据的情况下进行预测。然而，现有的基于LLM的方法依赖于行提示，导致推理成本很高并且行间依赖关系的使用有限。在这项工作中，我们提出了 TABHGR+，这是一种用于表格数据的高效关系感知零样本框架，它利用 LLM 生成的规则来标记和分组行。具体来说，根据列和任务描述，我们使用 LLM 生成为所有行分配弱标签的规则。为了细化这些嘈杂的弱标签，我们通过使用 LLM 生成的规则对语义相关的行进行分组来构建超图，并执行基于超图的标签传播。最后，我们通过为超边分配标签自适应权重，进一步增强了 LLM 生成的用于传播的超图，这可能是次优的。通过仅需要恒定数量的 LLM 调用（与数据集大小无关），TABHGR+ 大大降低了推理成本，同时实现了比零样本和强少样本基线更高的分类精度。

items.title: Improving Fake Profile Detection Through Multimodal Learning and Research-Guided Feature Integration
items.titleZh: 通过多模态学习和研究引导的特征集成改进虚假个人资料检测
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.23926v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Fake accounts continue to undermine online platforms, yet it remains unclear whether multimodal learning offers meaningful improvements over strong metadata baselines or graph-based approaches. In this work, we study bot detection by integrating textual, visual, and account metadata signals on the TwiBot-22 benchmark using a subsample of 30,000 users. We propose a multimodal framework combining pretrained textual (XLM-RoBERTa) and visual (CLIP) embeddings with structured account-level features such as follower counts, posting frequency, and account age, and evaluate multiple modality combinations using CatBoost alongside a Relational Graph Convolutional Network (R-GCN). Results show that metadata alone is highly predictive, while multimodal fusion yields only marginal and largely statistically insignificant gains. The graph-based model underperforms classical variants under the subsampled graph conditions of this study. Overall, our findings suggest that under practical constraints, feature quality and metadata richness matter more than fusion complexity.

arXiv:2610.23926v1 公告类型：新
摘要：虚假账户继续破坏在线平台，但目前尚不清楚多模式学习是否能比强大的元数据基线或基于图形的方法提供有意义的改进。在这项工作中，我们通过使用 30,000 个用户的子样本在 TwiBot-22 基准上集成文本、视觉和帐户元数据信号来研究机器人检测。我们提出了一个多模态框架，将预训练的文本 (XLM-RoBERTa) 和视觉 (CLIP) 嵌入与结构化帐户级特征（例如关注者数量、发帖频率和帐户年龄）相结合，并使用 CatBoost 和关系图卷积网络 (R-GCN) 来评估多种模态组合。结果表明，元数据本身具有高度预测性，而多模态融合只能产生边际收益，而且在统计上基本上不显着。在本研究的二次采样图条件下，基于图的模型的性能低于经典模型。总的来说，我们的研究结果表明，在实际限制下，特征质量和元数据丰富性比融合复杂性更重要。

items.title: miniTE: Diagnosing and Bridging the Execution Gap in Native NVFP4 Reinforcement Learning
items.titleZh: miniTE：诊断和弥合本机 NVFP4 强化学习中的执行差距
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.23928v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Native NVFP4 promises to accelerate reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models (LLMs), but achieving stable learning across separate training and sampling engines remains challenging. We show that matching model weights and numerical formats is insufficient to ensure consistent policy evaluation, highlighting the importance of cross-engine numerical execution. We introduce miniTE, a lightweight framework that combines execution diagnostics, cross-engine numerical alignment, and efficient native W4A4 (4-bit weights and activations) GEMM computation for LLM RL. It improves numerical execution consistency without modifying the RL objective, while reducing implementation overhead to realize the benefits of native low-bit computation. Long-horizon RL experiments on Qwen3-30B-A3B demonstrate stable training and benchmark performance close to BF16, outperforming naive Transformer Engine (TE) NVFP4 in evaluation quality. On single NVIDIA B300 GPU node, the optimized learner reaches 33,540 tokens/s, yielding 1.39x and 1.47x the throughput of BF16 and TE NVFP4, respectively, for complete learner updates. We released the framework, kernels, diagnostics, and training configurations to make native low-bit RL easier.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.23928v1 公告类型：新
摘要：原生 NVFP4 有望加速大型语言模型 (LLM) 的强化学习 (RL)，但跨单独的训练和采样引擎实现稳定的学习仍然具有挑战性。我们表明，匹配模型权重和数值格式不足以确保一致的策略评估，凸显了跨引擎数值执行的重要性。我们推出了 miniTE，这是一个轻量级框架，它结合了 LLM RL 的执行诊断、跨引擎数值对齐和高效的原生 W4A4（4 位权重和激活）GEMM 计算。它在不修改 RL 目标的情况下提高了数值执行的一致性，同时减少了实现开销以实现本机低位计算的优势。 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上的长视野 RL 实验证明了稳定的训练和接近 BF16 的基准性能，在评估质量方面优于朴素 Transformer Engine (TE) NVFP4。在单个 NVIDIA B300 GPU 节点上，优化后的学习器达到 33,540 个令牌/秒，对于完整的学习器更新，吞吐量分别是 BF16 和 TE NVFP4 的 1.39 倍和 1.47 倍。我们发布了框架、内核、诊断和训练配置，以使原生低位 RL 变得更容易。

items.title: Organizing LLM Inference for Aggregate Predictions from Behavioral Data
items.titleZh: 组织 LLM 推理以根据行为数据进行聚合预测
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.23934v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: When using a large language model (LLM) to simulate a user population, how should we combine individual behavioral histories to predict the fraction of users who take a particular action? We study this question in e-commerce, predicting observed product-level conversion rates from browsing sessions without task-specific model training. We vary two design choices, each involving a bias-variance tradeoff. Summarizing a product's sessions before inference reduces cost but can discard predictive detail, adding bias, whereas predicting outcomes for individual sessions and averaging afterward preserves that detail but requires many calls to reduce variance. Evaluating products together in one prompt can help the model infer what is typical in the setting, reducing bias, but also makes each prediction depend on which other products appear alongside it, adding noise. We evaluate both choices across five LLMs and two datasets. Our main finding is that predictions from individual sessions outperform predictions from summaries when products are evaluated separately, but summaries lead when products are evaluated together. Comparative summaries achieve the highest Spearman correlation with observed rates in 12 of 15 settings, with no alternative significantly better. Comparison thus helps summaries far more than session predictions, overcoming the advantage of behavioral detail. We interpret this difference through a Bayesian model of the second tradeoff, which suggests that comparison helps more when the inputs in a prompt reveal more about differences across products, consistent with our results for four types of comparative context. Comparative summaries also incur a small fraction of the inference cost of the session methods. With the best model for each outcome, they attain 66-89% of the correlation of the best supervised benchmark trained on thousands of labeled products.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.23934v1 公告类型：新
摘要：当使用大型语言模型（LLM）来模拟用户群体时，我们应该如何结合个人行为历史来预测采取特定操作的用户比例？我们在电子商务中研究这个问题，在没有特定任务模型训练的情况下，通过浏览会话来预测观察到的产品级转化率。我们改变两种设计选择，每种选择都涉及偏差-方差权衡。在推理之前总结产品的会话可以降低成本，但可能会丢弃预测细节，增加偏差，而预测各个会话的结果并在事后求平均值可以保留该细节，但需要多次调用才能减少方差。在一个提示中一起评估产品可以帮助模型推断设置中的典型情况，减少偏差，但也会使每个预测依赖于与它一起出现的其他产品，从而增加噪音。我们评估了五个法学硕士和两个数据集的这两种选择。我们的主要发现是，当单独评估产品时，来自各个会话的预测优于来自摘要的预测，但当一起评估产品时，摘要会领先。比较总结在 15 个设置中的 12 个设置中与观察到的比率实现了最高的 Spearman 相关性，没有其他选择明显更好。因此，比较比会话预测更有帮助，克服了行为细节的优势。我们通过第二个权衡的贝叶斯模型来解释这种差异，这表明当提示中的输入更多地揭示产品之间的差异时，比较会更有帮助，这与我们对四种比较环境的结果一致。比较摘要也会产生会话方法的推理成本的一小部分。通过针对每个结果的最佳模型，他们获得了在数千种标记产品上训练的最佳监督基准的 66-89% 的相关性。

items.title: Factorization-Guided Training and Inference for Diffusion-Drafted Speculative Decoding
items.titleZh: 扩散起草推测解码的因式分解引导训练和推理
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.23935v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference through parallel verification of tokens proposed by a drafter. Diffusion drafters further parallelize proposal generation, but greater proposal capacity or higher mean accepted tokens (MAT) need not yield higher throughput. Because verification accepts only a consecutive prefix, early rejections can render later correct predictions ineffective, limiting MAT gains, while even higher MAT may not improve throughput if per-round latency increases. We introduce DScout, which uses two complementary factorizations to guide diffusion drafter training and inference for higher throughput. For training, DScout factorizes position-wise loss into inclusion, weighting, and prediction loss. This guides the design and combination of mixed-horizon training, intra-block unmasking, and acceptance-weighted loss to align supervision with prefix acceptance and improve MAT. For inference, DScout factorizes throughput as the ratio of MAT to per-round latency, guiding target-conditioning depth, drafter depth, and inference block size selection to identify a high-throughput configuration for each workload. Across six benchmarks, DScout achieves $3.84\times$ and $4.14\times$ mean speedups over autoregressive decoding on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, respectively, improving mean speedup over the state-of-the-art baseline by 9.1% and 7.1%. Across models and concurrency settings, our inference configuration policy provides up to 9.75% additional mean speedup over DScout's fixed configuration.

arXiv:2610.23935v1 公告类型：新
摘要：推测解码通过并行验证起草者提出的标记来加速大型语言模型推理。扩散起草者进一步并行化提案生成，但更大的提案容量或更高的平均接受令牌（MAT）不需要产生更高的吞吐量。由于验证仅接受连续前缀，因此早期拒绝可能会使以后的正确预测无效，从而限制 MAT 增益，而如果每轮延迟增加，则更高的 MAT 可能不会提高吞吐量。我们引入 DScout，它使用两种互补分解来指导扩散绘图员训练和推理，以实现更高的吞吐量。对于训练，DScout 将位置损失分解为包含损失、加权损失和预测损失。这指导了混合水平训练、块内揭露和接受加权损失的设计和组合，以使监督与前缀接受保持一致并改进 MAT。对于推理，DScout 将吞吐量分解为 MAT 与每轮延迟的比率，指导目标调节深度、起草器深度和推理块大小选择，以确定每个工作负载的高吞吐量配置。在六个基准测试中，DScout 比 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 上的自回归解码分别实现了 3.84\times$ 和 $4.14\times$ 平均加速，与最先进的基线相比平均加速提高了 9.1% 和 7.1%。在模型和并发设置中，我们的推理配置策略比 DScout 的固定配置提供高达 9.75% 的额外平均加速。
items.author: Jiakun Fan, Min Xiao, Qiang Wang, Neiwen Ling, Zhichao Liu, Zhihao Jia, Dimitrios S. Nikolopoulos, Zijun Wei

items.title: Beyond Prediction: A Component-Level Study of Concept Recovery in In-Context Learning
items.titleZh: 超越预测：情境学习中概念恢复的组件级研究
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.23936v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enables language models to make accurate predictions from demonstrations, but prediction success alone does not reveal the extent to which the underlying concept has been recovered. Existing evaluations typically assess recovery at the level of the whole concept, making it difficult to identify which components are recovered and to separate model limitations from ambiguity in the demonstrations. We introduce a component-level framework for concept recovery that decomposes concepts into their defining components and uses controlled structural interventions to evaluate both component-level and whole-concept recovery under identifiable demonstrations. Across four instruction-tuned LLMs and three composition forms, we find that models often achieve high prediction accuracy despite poor whole-concept recovery, with systematic over-specification of relevant attributes and level constraints. Individual structural components are generally insufficient for whole-concept recovery, whereas jointly specifying complementary components, particularly relevant attributes and their level constraints, substantially improves recovery. However, this improvement is fragile: a single plausible but unnecessary level constraint can substantially disrupt recovery. Finally, joint supervision of recovery and implicit prediction substantially improves recovery while preserving prediction performance, with the learned capability transferring across composition forms. Overall, our component-level analysis provides a more diagnostic view of what models recover from demonstrations than the existing holistic view.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.23936v1 公告类型：新
摘要：上下文学习（ICL）使语言模型能够从演示中做出准确的预测，但仅预测成功并不能揭示基本概念已恢复的程度。现有的评估通常在整个概念的层面上评估恢复情况，因此很难确定恢复了哪些组件，也很难将模型的局限性与演示中的模糊性区分开来。我们引入了用于概念恢复的组件级框架，该框架将概念分解为其定义组件，并使用受控结构干预来评估可识别演示下的组件级和整体概念恢复。在四个指令调整的法学硕士和三种组合形式中，我们发现尽管整体概念恢复较差，并且对相关属性和级别约束进行了系统性的过度规范，但模型通常仍能实现较高的预测精度。单个结构组件通常不足以进行整体概念恢复，而联合指定补充组件，特别是相关属性及其水平约束，可以显着改善恢复。然而，这种改进是脆弱的：单一看似合理但不必要的水平限制可能会严重破坏恢复。最后，恢复和隐式预测的联合监督大大提高了恢复，同时保留了预测性能，并且学习到的能力可以跨组合形式转移。总体而言，与现有的整体视图相比，我们的组件级分析提供了关于模型从演示中恢复的更具诊断性的视图。
items.author: Xufeng Liu, Fang Wan, Yi Liu

items.title: SECURE-AI: Multi-Signal Uncertainty Quantification for Trustworthy Acoustic Cough Detection
items.titleZh: SECURE-AI：多信号不确定性量化，用于可靠的声学咳嗽检测
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.23937v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Acoustic models for cough detection achieve high accuracy on curated benchmarks but fail silently in deployment, where speech, environmental noise, and audio unlike the training data induce confident misclassifications. In health monitoring, a confidently wrong prediction is worse than no answer at all. We present SECURE-AI (Self-aware Estimation of Cough Uncertainty for Reliable Evaluation of AI), a multi-signal uncertainty quantification framework that wraps a frozen MobileNetV3 cough classifier and estimates when its predictions should not be trusted, combining Monte Carlo Dropout, Temperature Scaling, and Mahalanobis distance in the embedding space. On a held-out split of 12,161 Coswara recordings, the probability-space methods are individually insufficient: Monte Carlo Dropout assigns lower uncertainty to incorrect than to correct predictions, and temperature scaling improves calibration but not discrimination. The strongest signal is embedding-space distance: Mahalanobis distance separates true positives from false positives (means 44.7 versus 63.4; Cohen's $d = 0.94$; AUROC 0.86) and, among predicted non-coughs, false negatives from true negatives (AUROC 0.82), so the same signal can flag both false alarms and missed coughs. At a descriptive operating point selected from labeled test data, retaining 90 percent of true-positive detections removes about two-thirds of false positives and raises precision from 59.9 to roughly 80 percent. A rejection threshold tuned on one split does not transfer to another (validation F1 of 82 percent falls to 34 percent on test), so we report threshold-independent AUROC as the main measure. An error taxonomy shows that failures are systematic, with most false positives related to speech. The pipeline runs on Raspberry Pi hardware costing 30 to 90 US dollars. Probabilistic calibration alone is thus inadequate for reliable cough detection.

arXiv:2610.23937v1 公告类型：新
摘要：用于咳嗽检测的声学模型在策划的基准上实现了高精度，但在部署中却默默地失败了，其中与训练数据不同的语音、环境噪声和音频会导致可信的错误分类。在健康监测中，自信错误的预测比没有答案更糟糕。我们提出了 SECURE-AI（用于可靠评估 AI 的咳嗽不确定性的自我意识估计），这是一种多信号不确定性量化框架，它封装了冻结的 MobileNetV3 咳嗽分类器，并在嵌入空间中结合了蒙特卡罗 Dropout、温度缩放和马哈拉诺比斯距离来估计其预测何时不应被信任。在 12,161 个 Coswara 记录的保留分割中，概率空间方法各自不足：蒙特卡洛 Dropout 为错误预测分配的不确定性低于正确预测，温度缩放改进了校准，但没有提高辨别力。最强的信号是嵌入空间距离：马哈拉诺比斯距离将真阳性与假阳性分开（平均值为 44.7 对 63.4；Cohen 的 $d = 0.94$；AUROC 0.86），并且在预测的非咳嗽中，将假阴性与真阴性分开（AUROC 0.82），因此同一信号可以标记误报和漏诊咳嗽。在从标记测试数据中选择的描述性操作点，保留 90% 的真阳性检测可以消除约三分之二的假阳性，并将精度从 59.9% 提高到大约 80%。针对一个分割调整的拒绝阈值不会转移到另一个分割（测试时验证 F1 为 82%，降至 34%），因此我们将与阈值无关的 AUROC 报告为主要衡量标准。错误分类显示失败是系统性的，大多数误报与语音有关。该管道在价格为 30 至 90 美元的 Raspberry Pi 硬件上运行。因此，单独的概率校准不足以实现可靠的咳嗽检测。

items.title: Pack and Extract: An Effective Graph-Based Approach for Feature Selection
items.titleZh: 打包和提取：一种有效的基于图的特征选择方法
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.23938v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Many molecular biology data sets contain thousands of features, such as genes in single-cell experiments or other omics data. Standard predictive models often perform poorly in such settings, as they tend to retain a large number of features and fail to adequately handle correlations among them. Combinatorial approaches, such as feature selection based on the Independent Dominating Set (IDS) model, have shown promising results, but appear to have been largely overlooked, possibly due to their high computational complexity. In this paper, we propose an improvement to IDS-based feature selection that (i) favors features exhibiting greater diversity and (ii) generalizes the notion of independent dominating set to a node packing model. The resulting formulation is used as an intermediate step within the feature selection process. We evaluate our approach on five genetic data sets and compare the results with those obtained using existing methods. Our experimental results demonstrate notable improvements in predictive accuracy over traditional models, as well as increased stability of the selected feature sets.

arXiv:2610.23938v1 公告类型：新
摘要：许多分子生物学数据集包含数千个特征，例如单细胞实验中的基因或其他组学数据。标准预测模型在这种情况下通常表现不佳，因为它们往往保留大量特征并且无法充分处理它们之间的相关性。组合方法，例如基于独立支配集（IDS）模型的特征选择，已经显示出有希望的结果，但似乎在很大程度上被忽视了，可能是由于其高计算复杂性。在本文中，我们提出了对基于 IDS 的特征选择的改进，即（i）有利于表现出更大多样性的特征，（ii）将独立支配集的概念推广到节点包装模型。所得公式用作特征选择过程中的中间步骤。我们在五个遗传数据集上评估我们的方法，并将结果与​​使用现有方法获得的结果进行比较。我们的实验结果表明，与传统模型相比，预测准确性显着提高，并且所选特征集的稳定性也有所提高。

items.title: PeekKV: The First Content Token Already Knows Which Heads Matter
items.titleZh: PeekKV：第一个内容代币已经知道哪些头很重要
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.23939v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: The size of the KV cache grows linearly with context length, making it a major memory bottleneck in LLM serving. Motivated by recent progress in identifying the functional roles of attention heads, a growing body of work compresses the KV cache non-uniformly across heads. Existing methods either fix the important heads via offline profiling or select them using attention signals from the prefill stage. In both cases, however, accuracy fluctuates substantially across workloads. While investigating the cause of this instability, we find that the active heads shift between the prefill and decode stages even within a single input. Along the decode path, by contrast, the activehead composition remains stable across content tokens once format tokens are filtered out. Based on this observation, we propose PeekKV. PeekKV observes a single content token immediately after prefill - a one-token peek - to jointly obtain head-group scores and token-importance scores. Guided by these scores, PeekKV allocates KV cache budgets to head groups in proportion to their group scores and retains only the top-scoring tokens within each budget. PeekKV requires no offline profiling or training and thus applies directly to unseen workloads and new models. Across four public benchmarks, PeekKV achieves the highest accuracy in more than half of the per-model comparisons against state-of-the-art methods, and stays closest to the full-cache accuracy on RULER and LongBench. On Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, PeekKV retains 95.7% of the full-cache accuracy at a 10% memory budget on RULER with 16K contexts and 95.9% at a 1.5% budget on LongBench.
items.summaryZh:
arXiv:2610.23939v1 公告类型：新
摘要：KV 缓存的大小随着上下文长度线性增长，使其成为 LLM 服务中的主要内存瓶颈。受最近在识别注意力头功能角色方面取得的进展的推动，越来越多的工作在各个头之间非均匀地压缩 KV 缓存。现有的方法要么通过离线分析来修复重要的头，要么使用来自预填充阶段的注意信号来选择它们。然而，在这两种情况下，不同工作负载的准确性都会大幅波动。在调查这种不稳定的原因时，我们发现即使在单个输入中，活动磁头也会在预填充和解码阶段之间移动。相比之下，沿着解码路径，一旦过滤掉格式令牌，活动头组成在内容令牌之间保持稳定。基于这一观察，我们提出了 PeekKV。 PeekKV 在预填充后立即观察单个内容标记（单标记窥视），以联合获得头组分数和标记重要性分数。在这些分数的指导下，PeekKV 根据组分数的比例将 KV 缓存预算分配给头组，并仅保留每个预算中得分最高的令牌。 PeekKV 不需要离线分析或培训，因此可以直接应用于未见过的工作负载和新模型。在四个公共基准测试中，PeekKV 在超过一半的每个模型与最先进方法的比较中实现了最高准确度，并且在 RULER 和 LongBench 上保持最接近的全缓存准确度。在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上，PeekKV 在具有 16K 上下文的 RULER 上以 10% 内存预算保留了 95.7% 的全缓存精度，在 LongBench 上以 1.5% 预算保留了 95.9%。

items.title: Fast Construction of Inner Sphere Trees Using Machine Learning
items.titleZh: 使用机器学习快速构建内球树
items.summary:
arXiv:2610.23940v1 Announce Type: new
Abstract: Collision detection for complex non-convex objects is a bottleneck in physics simulation, virtual reality, and robotics. Inner sphere trees (ISTs) answer proximity and penetration queries efficiently, but their greedy leaf-sphere construction is sequential and computationally expensive, which limits both large-scale preprocessing and runtime use. In this work, we present ML-IST, a machine-learning-based method that reformulates leaf-sphere generation as a single-shot set-prediction problem: a network predicts a fixed set of inscribed sphere candidates from multichannel voxel geometry, differentiable coverage feedback corrects the coarse prediction and fills residual gaps at finer scales, and a lightweight geometric projection enforces validity. Averaged over the test set, a single-GPU implementation of ML-IST reduces mean leaf-generation time by a factor of $2.0$--$2.6$ over single-core CPU construction across target capacities of 64--512 spheres, and qualitative results on complex models show multiscale sphere distributions that follow principal volumes and slender features. We further integrate ML-IST into the Jolt Physics and Bullet engines; in an alpha-puzzle benchmark it reaches 55.89~FPS, the highest among the compared representations (conventional IST, GImpact, and convex decomposition). These results support learned leaf generation as a practical component for fast, runtime construction of detailed collision representations.

arXiv:2610.23940v1 公告类型：新
摘要：复杂非凸物体的碰撞检测是物理模拟、虚拟现实和机器人技术的瓶颈。内球树（IST）可以有效地回答邻近和渗透查询，但它们贪婪的叶球体构造是连续的并且计算成本高昂，这限制了大规模预处理和运行时使用。在这项工作中，我们提出了 ML-IST，一种基于机器学习的方法，它将叶球体生成重新表述为单次集合预测问题：网络从多通道体素几何中预测一组固定的内接球体候选者，可微覆盖反馈纠正粗略预测并在更精细的尺度上填充残留间隙，而轻量级几何投影则增强了有效性。在测试集上平均，ML-IST 的单 GPU 实现比单核 CPU 结构减少了 64--512 个球体目标容量的平均叶生成时间 2.0--2.6 美元，复杂模型的定性结果显示遵循主体积和细长特征的多尺度球体分布。我们进一步将 ML-IST 集成到 Jolt 物理和 Bullet 引擎中；在 alpha-puzzle 基准测试中，它达到 55.89~FPS，是比较表示形式（传统 IST、GImpact 和凸分解）中最高的。这些结果支持学习叶子生成作为快速、运行时构建详细碰撞表示的实用组件。
